newsitem.title: USA: Cityscape may file to offer 5 mln shares.
newsitem.headline: Cityscape may file to offer 5 mln shares.

text.p: Cityscape Financial Corp said Friday it is considering filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission for a public offering of about five million shares of common stock.
Four million of the shares would be sold by Cityscape and one million would be sold by certain stockholders of the company, including members of management, the company said.
Following such an offering, members of the company's management and board of directors would hold about 60.7 percent of the approximately 33.6 million outstanding common shares.
No members of management are currently contemplating the sale of Cityscape shares, other than in a pro-rata participation in the contemplated offering, the company said.
